actual_judgment.reason: The agent worked on the right task and produced an XLSX plus regeneration scripts, but the delivered data is materially incomplete: its own JSON/README/final response state Kickstarter had 2,871 upcoming tabletop projects while only the newest 120 across 10 pages were included due to 429 rate limits. The task required latest upcoming projects from both platforms with pagination handling, so omitting most Kickstarter results is substantial missing coverage, not a completed report. The blocker was documented but left unresolved rather than establishing the task was genuinely impossible.

import zipfile, re
with zipfile.ZipFile('upcoming_projects_report.xlsx') as z:
 s=z.read('xl/worksheets/sheet1.xml').decode()
 print('rows', len(re.findall(r'<row r=',s))-1)
 print('hyperlinks', s.count('<hyperlink '))
 print('sheet name ok?', b'Upcoming Projects' in z.read('xl/workbook.xml'))
PY
